Loading Eucalypt occurrences
```{r}
library(sp)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

euc_names <- read.csv("data/name_matched_list.csv", header=T)

euc_coords <- read.csv("data/euc_coords.csv", header=T) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  filter(scientificName %in% euc_names$current_name)

coords <- cbind(euc_coords$decimalLongitude, euc_coords$decimalLatitude)

euc_sp <- SpatialPoints(coords, proj4string=CRS("+init=epsg:4326"))

```


Loading precipitation rasters from worldclim
```{r}
library(raster)

MAP <- raster("data/MAP.tif")
MAT <- raster("data/MAT.tif")
seasonality <- raster("data/seasonality.tif")
wetq <- raster("data/wet_quarter.tif")
dryq <- raster("data/dry_quarter.tif")
```


Extracting climate data from points
```{r}
euc_coords$MAP <- raster::extract(MAP, euc_sp)
euc_coords$MAT <- raster::extract(MAT, euc_sp)
euc_coords$seasonality <- raster::extract(seasonality, euc_sp)
euc_coords$wetq <- raster::extract(wetq, euc_sp)
euc_coords$dryq <- raster::extract(dryq, euc_sp)

euc_climate_data <- euc_coords %>% 
  group_by(scientificName) %>% 
  summarise(mean_MAP=mean(MAP), 
            min_MAP=min(MAP),
            MAT=mean(MAT),
            seasonality=mean(seasonality),
            wetq=mean(wetq),
            dryq=mean(dryq)) %>% 
  drop_na()
```

Creating master spreadsheet
```{r}
image_data <- read.csv("data/xylem_areas2.csv", header=T) 

euc_database <- image_data %>% 
  separate(Image, c("family", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") %>% 
  separate(other, c("species", "state", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(species, state, other, Name, Area.µm.2)) %>% 
  mutate(radius = sqrt(Area.µm.2/pi)) %>% 
  left_join(euc_names, by = "species") %>% 
  left_join(euc_climate_data, by = c("current_name" = "scientificName"))

```


Calculating Hydraulically weighted diameter Dh
```{r}
xylem_Dh <- euc_database %>% 
  filter(Name=="vessel") %>% 
  mutate(r5 = radius^5,
         r4 = radius^4) %>% 
  group_by(current_name, other) %>% 
  summarise(Dh = sum(r5)/ sum(r4)) %>% 
  group_by(current_name) %>% 
  summarise(mean_Dh = mean(Dh)) %>% 
  left_join(euc_climate_data, by = c("current_name" = "scientificName")) %>% 
  mutate(highly_seasonal = seasonality > 60) %>% 
  drop_na()

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

mean_MAP_Dh <- xylem_Dh %>% ggplot(aes(mean_MAP, mean_Dh, col=highly_seasonal)) + geom_point()
min_MAP_Dh <- xylem_Dh %>% ggplot(aes(min_MAP, mean_Dh, col=highly_seasonal)) + geom_point()
MAT_Dh <- xylem_Dh %>% ggplot(aes(MAT, mean_Dh, col=highly_seasonal)) + geom_point()
wetq_Dh <- xylem_Dh %>% ggplot(aes(wetq, mean_Dh, col=highly_seasonal)) + geom_point()
dryq_Dh <- xylem_Dh %>% ggplot(aes(dryq, mean_Dh, col=highly_seasonal)) + geom_point()
seasonality_Dh <- xylem_Dh %>% ggplot(aes(seasonality, mean_Dh)) + geom_point()

plot(mean_MAP_Dh)
plot(min_MAP_Dh)
plot(MAT_Dh)
plot(wetq_Dh)
plot(dryq_Dh)
plot(seasonality_Dh)
```


Adding to climate pref data
```{r}
species_climate <- species_sum %>% 
  left_join(euc_database, by = "species") %>% 
  left_join(climate_prefs, by = c("current_name" = "scientificName"))

species_climate <- species_climate %>% 
  group_by(current_name) %>% 
  summarise(MAP=mean(MAP, na.rm=T), 
            MAT=mean(MAT, na.rm=T),
            seasonality=mean(seasonality, na.rm=T),
            wet_quarter=mean(wet_quarter, na.rm=T),
            dry_quarter=mean(dry_quarter, na.rm=T),
            mean_area=mean(mean_area, na.rm=T)) %>% 
  drop_na()


```

Plotting area to climate variables
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

MAP_plot <- ggplot(species_climate, aes(x=mean_area, y=MAP)) + geom_point()
MAT_plot <- ggplot(species_climate, aes(x=mean_area, y=MAT)) + geom_point()
seasonality_plot <- ggplot(species_climate, aes(x=mean_area, y=seasonality)) + geom_point() + scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10()
wetq_plot <- ggplot(species_climate, aes(x=mean_area, y=wet_quarter)) + geom_point()
dryq_plot <- ggplot(species_climate, aes(x=mean_area, y=dry_quarter)) + geom_point()

MAP_plot + MAT_plot
wetq_plot + dryq_plot
seasonality_plot
```

Data transform
```{r}
species_climate$log_area <- log(species_climate$mean_area)
species_climate$log_MAP <- log(species_climate$MAP)
species_climate$log_wetq <- log(species_climate$wet_quarter)

ggplot(species_climate, aes(x=log_area, y=log_MAP)) + geom_point()
logMAP_plot <- ggplot(species_climate, aes(x=log_area, y=log_MAP, label = rownames(species_climate))) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_text(check_overlap = T) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)

logWetq_plot <- ggplot(species_climate, aes(x=log_area, y=log_wetq)) + geom_point()

logMAP_plot + logWetq_plot

MAP_lm <- lm(log_MAP~log_area, data = species_climate)
summary(MAP_lm)
plot(MAP_lm, which=1)

Wetq_lm <- lm(log_wetq~log_area, data = species_climate)
summary(Wetq_lm)
plot(Wetq_lm, which=1)
```

Calculating hydraulically weighted diameter
```{r}
#areas <- areas %>% 
 # separate(Image, c("family", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") %>% 
  #separate(other, c("species", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge")

species_diameters <- areas
species_diameters$radius <- sqrt(species_diameters$Area.µm.2/pi)
species_diameters$r5 <- species_diameters$radius^5
species_diameters$r4 <- species_diameters$radius^4
species_diameters$diameter <- species_diameters$radius*2

species_diameters <- species_diameters %>% 
  group_by(species, other, Name) %>% 
  summarise(sum_r5 = sum(r5),
            sum_r4 = sum(r4),
            n = n())

species_diameters$Dh <- species_diameters$sum_r5/species_diameters$sum_r4

xylem_Dh <- species_diameters %>% filter(Name == "vessel")
xylem_Dh <- xylem_Dh %>% group_by(species) %>% summarise(mean_Dh = mean(Dh)) %>% 
  left_join(euc_database, by = "species") %>% 
  left_join(species_climate, by = "current_name") %>% 
  drop_na()

Dh_MAP_plot <- ggplot(xylem_Dh, aes(y=mean_Dh, x=MAP)) + geom_point()
Dh_MAT_plot <- ggplot(xylem_Dh, aes(y=mean_Dh, x=MAT)) + geom_point()
Dh_wetq_plot <- ggplot(xylem_Dh, aes(y=mean_Dh, x=wet_quarter)) + geom_point()
Dh_dryq_plot <- ggplot(xylem_Dh, aes(y=mean_Dh, x=dry_quarter)) + geom_point()
Dh_seasonality <- ggplot(xylem_Dh, aes(y=mean_Dh, x=seasonality)) + geom_point()

plot(Dh_MAP_plot + Dh_MAT_plot + Dh_wetq_plot + Dh_dryq_plot)
plot(Dh_seasonality)
#plot(Dh_wetq_plot + Dh_dryq_plot)
```

Calculating lumen fraction
```{r}
species_areas <- areas %>% 
  group_by(species, other, Name) %>% 
  summarise(total_area = sum(Area.µm.2, na.rm=T))

species_areas_wider <- species_areas %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Name, values_from = total_area)
species_areas_wider <- species_areas_wider %>% 
  mutate(total_vessel = vessel + part,
         lumen_fraction = total_vessel/PathAnnotationObject)

lumen_fractions <- species_areas_wider %>% 
  group_by(species) %>% 
  summarise(mean_lumen_frac = mean(lumen_fraction))

lumen_fractions <- lumen_fractions %>% 
  left_join(euc_database, by = "species") %>% 
  left_join(species_climate, by = "current_name") %>% 
  drop_na()

lumen_MAP_plot <- ggplot(lumen_fractions, aes(y=mean_lumen_frac, x=MAP)) + geom_point()
lumen_MAT_plot <- ggplot(lumen_fractions, aes(y=mean_lumen_frac, x=MAT)) + geom_point()
lumen_wetq_plot <- ggplot(lumen_fractions, aes(y=mean_lumen_frac, x=wet_quarter)) + geom_point()
lumen_dryq_plot <- ggplot(lumen_fractions, aes(y=mean_lumen_frac, x=dry_quarter)) + geom_point()

plot(lumen_MAP_plot + lumen_MAT_plot + lumen_wetq_plot + lumen_dryq_plot)
#plot(lumen_wetq_plot + lumen_dryq_plot)
```

Comparing lumenfrac to diameter
```{r}
Dh_lumen <- lumen_fractions[1:2] %>% left_join(xylem_Dh[1:2], by = "species") %>% 
  left_join(xylem_Dh[, c(1,5)], by = "species")

Dh_lumen_plot <- ggplot(Dh_lumen, aes(x=mean_Dh, y=mean_lumen_frac)) +
  geom_point()

plot(Dh_lumen_plot)


```

```{r}
library(vegan)

vessel_data <- Dh_lumen[,2:4]
vessel_mds <- metaMDS(comm = vessel_data, distance = "bray", trace = FALSE, autotransform = FALSE)
plot(vessel_mds$points)
```
